processors.comment: get the current value version, then do a atomic put
processors.script: const k = `example`; const r = JSON.parse(context.sendToStep(`aws-dynamodb-persistence`, `get`, JSON.stringify([k])).getBody()); r[k] ? version = r[k].version : null; context.sendToStep(`aws-dynamodb-persistence`, `put`, JSON.stringify( { currentVersion : r[k].version, key : k, value : JSON.parse(context.getBody()).body } ))
